title: Architecture Guide
summary: Explains the design philosophy and layered architecture of @conduction/nextcloud-vue.

title: Component Library
summary: Defines the foundational conventions all components in @conduction/nextcloud-vue MUST follow.

title: Component Reference
summary: Defines the per-component documentation pages that explain each Cn* component's purpose, props, events, slots, and usage examples.

title: Composables
summary: Specifies the Vue composables exported by @conduction/nextcloud-vue: useListView, useDetailView, useSubResource, and useDashboardView.

title: CnDashboardGrid
summary: CnDashboardGrid is the core grid layout engine that wraps GridStack.js.

title: CnDashboardPage
summary: CnDashboardPage is a top-level dashboard page component that assembles a header, a CnDashboardGrid, and widget rendering with automatic widget type detection.

title: Data Display
summary: Specifies the data display components: CnDataTable, CnCardGrid, CnObjectCard, CnCellRenderer, CnStatusBadge, CnPagination, CnFilterBar, CnFacetSidebar, CnKpiGrid.

title: Dialog System
summary: Specifies the two-phase dialog pattern used by all 8 dialog components: CnDeleteDialog, CnCopyDialog, CnFormDialog, CnAdvancedFormDialog, CnMassDeleteDialog, CnMassCopyDialog, CnMassExportDialog, CnMassImportDialog.

title: Getting Started Guide
summary: Provides a quick-start guide for building a new Nextcloud app using @conduction/nextcloud-vue.

title: CnIndexPage
summary: CnIndexPage is the top-level, schema-driven index page component that assembles sub-components (CnPageHeader, CnActionsBar, CnDataTable, CnCardGrid, CnPagination, CnRowActions, CnMassActionBar, and all 7 dialog components) into a single zero-config page for listing, selecting, and managing objects.

title: Integration Guides
summary: Documents how @conduction/nextcloud-vue connects to external systems, specifically OpenRegister (the backend schema/object engine), the NL Design System (theming layer), and the consumer app ecosystem.

title: Layout Components
summary: Specifies the page layout components: CnPageHeader, CnActionsBar, CnFilterBar, CnFacetSidebar, CnMassActionBar, CnIndexSidebar.

title: Pages Editor Data Sources
summary: How the in-app pages editor discovers and refreshes the registers and schemas that feed its Register / Schema / Columns pickers.

title: Schema Utilities
summary: Specifies the utility functions that auto-generate table columns, form fields, and filter definitions from JSON Schema properties, plus helper utilities for value formatting, HTTP headers, query strings, and error parsing.

title: Settings Components
summary: Specifies the admin settings components: CnSettingsCard, CnSettingsSection, CnConfigurationCard, CnVersionInfoCard, CnStatsBlock, and CnRegisterMapping.

title: Store
summary: Specifies the Pinia object store (useObjectStore), factory function (createObjectStore), sub-resource plugin factory (createSubResourcePlugin), built-in plugins, and all supporting utilities for OpenRegister CRUD operations.

title: CnTileWidget
summary: CnTileWidget renders a quick-access tile with an icon and a link.

title: Timeline Stages Widget
summary: Provides a reusable Vue component for visualizing sequential progression through named stages.

title: useDashboardView
summary: UseDashboardView(options) is a composable exported by @conduction/nextcloud-vue that manages dashboard state: widget definitions, layout, NC Dashboard API widget loading, and layout persistence.

title: useDetailView
summary: UseDetailView(objectType, id, options?) is a composable exported by @conduction/nextcloud-vue that provides reactive object data, save/delete operations, loading state, and optional post-operation router navigation for detail/edit views.

title: useListView
summary: UseListView(objectType, options?) is a composable exported by @conduction/nextcloud-vue that provides everything a CnIndexPage-based list view needs: schema, reactive collection data, loading and pagination state, sidebar wiring, and event handlers for search, sort, filter, and pagination.

title: CnWidgetRenderer
summary: CnWidgetRenderer renders Nextcloud Dashboard API widgets (v1 and v2) with auto-refresh.

title: CnWidgetWrapper
summary: CnWidgetWrapper is a widget container shell that provides a consistent visual frame for all widget types: optional header with icon and title, scrollable content area, and optional footer.
